Passed 2025-08-15. Reading generated by ollama:deepseek-v4-pro from the enrolled text; the full text is at the foot of this page so every statement can be checked against it. LegiScan record · official text

What it does

This Illinois law amends the Public Community College Act to require that each community college board ensure a course is taught by an individual faculty member who meets specified qualifications, and it prohibits a course from using artificial intelligence as the sole source of instruction in place of a faculty member. It also clarifies that faculty members may use artificial intelligence to augment course instruction.

Who it applies to

  • Each board under the Public Community College Act
  • Faculty members who teach courses at community colleges
  • Courses offered by community colleges

Effective date

not stated in the text

Key definitions

  • artificial intelligence: has the same meaning given to the term in Section 2-101 of the Illinois Human Rights Act (Sec. 3-29.28(a))

Obligations

  • Each board must require that the faculty member who teaches a course is an individual who meets the qualifications set forth in 23 Ill. Adm. Code 1501.303(f) and any other applicable rules adopted by the State Board (Sec. 3-29.28(b))

Prohibitions

  • A course may not, in lieu of a faculty member, use artificial intelligence as the sole source of instruction for students (Sec. 3-29.28(b))

Penalties and enforcement

not stated in the text

How it affects AI deployment

  • An organization deploying AI in community college instruction cannot use AI as the sole source of instruction for a course in place of a faculty member (Sec. 3-29.28(b)).
  • An organization may allow faculty members to use AI to augment course instruction, as the statute does not prohibit that use (Sec. 3-29.28(c)).
  • An organization must ensure that each course has an individual faculty member meeting the specified qualifications, so AI cannot serve as the instructor of record (Sec. 3-29.28(b)).

Notable exemptions

  • Nothing in this Section prohibits a faculty member from using artificial intelligence to augment course instruction (Sec. 3-29.28(c))

Compliance steps

  • Review each course to confirm that a faculty member who is an individual meeting the qualifications in 23 Ill. Adm. Code 1501.303(f) and other applicable State Board rules is assigned to teach the course (Sec. 3-29.28(b)).
  • Ensure that no course uses artificial intelligence as the sole source of instruction in lieu of a faculty member (Sec. 3-29.28(b)).
  • Permit faculty members to use artificial intelligence to augment course instruction if they choose to do so (Sec. 3-29.28(c)).
